gaps: No verified public table of MEDIAN deposits / financial assets / net financial assets by income QUINTILE split urban vs rural (CHFS/CFPS microdata would be needed; CHFS public data at https://chfs.swufe.edu.cn/sjzx/gksjk.htm requires registration).

Most recent national urban+rural financial-asset medians verified are CHFS 2011 (urban 16,500; rural 3,000). Suggested game approach: scale 2011 medians by growth in per-household 住户存款 2011->2025 (needs a verified 2011 住户存款 figure, not collected here), and spread quintiles using CHFS saving concentration (top 10% income = ~75% of saving) and PBOC top-decile/bottom-quintile asset ratio 13.7x.
PBOC 2019 survey is urban-only and publishes debt participation by asset group and age, not income group.
No verified national median debt amount in CNY.
Recent (2017-2021) urban vs rural debt-participation rates from CHFS/CFPS not found in accessible text; latest split is CHFS 2011 (urban 35.2%, rural 40.3%).
Share with informal debt is from CHFS 2013 (rural 43.8%) via news report; no newer national figure verified.

National breakdown of rural borrowing purposes (house building vs medical vs weddings vs education) not found; only CHFS-based 'agri+housing+medical ~80% of rural debt' and Guangdong 2019 grouped purposes.
End-2025 household deposit stock (167.04tn) verified only via secondary quote; PBOC table itself not opened (lixinger table returned 403).
IMF DTI-by-quintile values are only in charts; only the narrative 'lowest quintile almost 6' was extractable.
2020 census rural tenure table not opened; 2010 census rural value used.
